approvalSource: explicit Platform Super Administrator instruction in conversation approving pay.ekodi.kr as the EKODI Payment common service and explicitly authorizing deployment
summary: Register pay.ekodi.kr as the provider-neutral EKODI Payment common-service boundary with workspace-scoped merchant ownership, guarded transaction activation and reversible route-fronted rollout.
boundaryReason: payments are a shared protocol and high-impact operational boundary reused by Mall, membership, courses, reservations, subscriptions, service fees and approved donations; the boundary does not identify a person or workspace
paymentAuthorityRule: payment ownership and authorization resolve from immutable workspace_id; provider accounts, merchant IDs and settlement accounts remain workspace-scoped and replaceable
providerRule: PortOne, Toss, NICE and future providers are adapters rather than EKODI payment identity or domain truth
fundsRule: platform fund pooling and redistribution are forbidden by default; direct settlement to the workspace merchant account is preferred unless a separately approved legal settlement model exists
sensitiveDataRule: raw card number, CVC and equivalent reusable payment credentials are never stored by EKODI Payment
donationRule: church donation payment execution stays disabled until the selected provider and merchant account explicitly approve the category
transitionRule: during the first verified release, the legacy pay.ekodi.kr shared-site Custom Domain remains as the rollback origin while the dedicated Payment Worker runs on a more specific Worker Route in front of it
verificationPolicy: constitution, payment contract tests, isolated staging, guarded candidate promotion and real pay.ekodi.kr health/capability/admin checks must pass before the release is reported complete
rollbackPlan: remove the pay.ekodi.kr/* Worker Route to restore the existing pay.ekodi.kr origin immediately; no payment database or provider credential migration occurs in this foundation release
